About the Role

Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We’re building out a high-velocity team of multi-disciplinary experts to turn real-world operations into high-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team will be focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real-world, long-tail driving data. Autonomy is now a data race–and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match (millions of Uber trips every hour across cities, conditions, and edge cases create the data autonomy has been missing).

We will build platforms that harness scale and real-world complexity to reimagine how the world moves.

You will be a software engineer in AV Labs and involved in the development and implementation of cutting edge technologies. The ideal candidate will be able to identify issues, provide solutions, and implement the fixes, as well as set a high technical excellence bar in all things we do.

What the Candidate Will Do:

  • Design and implement solutions for visualizing AV data.
  • Align visualization requirements with stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum 4 years of working experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related fields.
  • Proficient in web development such as React, Javascript, etc.
  • Background with AV visualization tools such as Foxglove, Webviz.

  • Master or PhD degree in Computer Science or related fields.

jobs.Description:
About the Role

Alongside Uber Eats, we are launching Uber Direct in Finland. Uber Direct is our white-label delivery service that enables merchants to offer fast, same-day delivery from their own websites, apps, or stores — with no need for customers to use the Uber app. 

You will own the initial GTM commercial strategy (pipeline creation and sales) for the market. As we launch our first merchants, you will then transition to also focus on scaling our merchants’ operations and driving long-term commercial health of our partnerships. You will be the vital link that translates high-level digital strategy into scalable, on-the-ground delivery operations.

Success here requires intrinsic drive to solve tough problems and the ability to influence and align stakeholders with competing priorities. You must stay steady under pressure, using data to navigate ambiguity and drive results for your partners. You will build deep expertise in the local delivery ecosystem and help define the standard for how the Finish market experiences on-demand last mile delivery.

What You'll Do

As a Growth Strategy Manager, you will be responsible for:

Sales: Closing the best partnerships with the right merchants, at the right commercials, with a strong cross-functional commercial team. You will work alongside our Restaurant and Retail teams to identify the right GTM approach (pipeline and commercial strategy) and win our first accounts to go live. 

Account Management: Driving growth, operational excellence and financial sustainability with our live merchant partners. Ensuring the end-to-end experience for our merchants is easy, and operations flow with high levels of reliability. Work closely with our scaled Operations team to escalate, resolve and improve when our experience is not at the desired level.

Financial and operational efficiency: You will build long-term relationships with your key accounts and be the main point of contact across the org, from Store Manager to HQ, focusing on improving their operations and optimizing our commercials.

Analysis: Quantify everything you do. Utilize an analytical approach to understand the performance of initiatives to ensure you are effectively prioritizing those with the highest return on investment.

Be proactive: This role will require fast thinking and moving swiftly through high-pressure environments. 

This is the ideal role for someone with a strategic mindset coupled with next-level sales and account management skills and an operational curiosity. You will have the rare opportunity to launch a market from scratch, pilot new features, operating models, and commercial structures, which can be playbooked and scaled across Uber.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of customer or client facing experience ideally in account management or consulting. Previous experience in setting and achieving business targets
  • Critical thinking and problem solving capabilities: Experience with challenging the status quo and identifying the root cause of hard problems to solve. 
  • Analytical skills: Comfortable with data analysis, spreadsheets and presenting findings and recommendations. Data driven decision making mentality and sound business judgment through strong analytical thinking.
  • Commercial acumen: Understanding of how businesses and organizations work and how to navigate a partner’s business. Ability to build sales pitches, negotiate deals and creative commercial strategies for our partners in a fast-growing market. 
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills and the ability to manage and influence diverse stakeholders across businesses and levels.
  • Project management: Able to create meticulously detailed execution plans for large-scale projects (e.g. launching a new product, onboarding a major enterprise) and then deliver them to plan regardless of any surprises or ambiguity along the way
  • Stakeholder management: Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders, e.g., Commercial, Operations, Product (Tech), Finance and Legal teams. 
  • Highly autonomous self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity: Able to come up with new ideas and execute them autonomously. Eager to learn with a #gogetit attitude. You should not be afraid to roll up your sleeves and get your hands dirty! 
  • Finish and English fluency a must

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of Last Mile Delivery space
  • SQL experience

Account Management at Uber means navigating ambiguity, earning trust fast, and solving problems that don’t come with a script. As a Senior Enterprise Account Manager, you will be the strategic link between Uber Eats and our most significant, fastest-growing restaurant brands. You aren't just managing a list of clients; you are conducting conversations with C-suite stakeholders and building joint business plans that ensure major brands thrive sustainably on our platform.

The work is high-stakes and requires a grit-based mindset to handle the pressure of enterprise expectations and the complexity of coordinating across global internal teams. You’ll need to turn operational data into actionable growth strategies while moving with urgency to resolve technical blockers that impact the customer experience at scale. If you are a resourceful owner who is energised by the challenge of writing the playbook for new market spaces and can stay resilient through tough commercial negotiations, this is where you will grow.

About the role

As an Implementation Lead for the French region, you'll work efficiently and effectively with our Uber for Business customers and be responsible for the successful and flawless launch of new accounts within the Uber for Business platform. You'll support our Sales and Account Management teams to drive revenue growth, operational excellence, and second-to-none customer service.

About the Role

We're looking for sharp, highly motivated individuals to join our team! As an Implementation/ Onboarding Lead, you'll work effectively with our top clients and be responsible for the success of client launch and implementation. You will aim to set our clients up for maximum adoption, usage, and future growth on the platform. You'll support our Enterprise and Mid-Market sales teams to drive revenue growth, operational excellence, and second-to-none customer service.

This is a hybrid role - our team collaborates in-person out of our incredible offices on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. We encourage our employees to work from our office on additional days if they desire to do so.

What You'll Do

  • Work with our customers and internal teams to understand the needs and goals of each customer. Use this understanding to create mutually beneficial goals and influence the customer.
  • Create a strategy for a seamless launch and implementation that enhances employee adoption and usage - continuing to supervise for 2-4 months post-launch and provide data-based recommendations for improvement.
  • Communicate effectively and manage internal and external stakeholders by setting and managing timelines and project plans for implementation.
  • Ensure customers are properly trained - Create a video or written collateral, host office hours, and/or facilitate training with customers on how to navigate the tools and programs.
  • Complete tactical and technical account set-up - including assisting with the setup of API, SFTP, or expense integrations and submitting Monthly Billing Applications to finance.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, marketing, and customer support to ensure a smooth onboarding and strong client experience. Think creatively about how we can solve problems and mitigate them from happening again
  • Demonstrated experience in managing internal stakeholders, including those at a higher  Comment start seniority level, with the ability to maintain one's position effectively.

Basic Qualifications

  • Min 3 years of experience in B2B client implementation, onboarding, project management, customer success, or a similar client-facing role, ideally within a technology, SaaS, payments, travel, or platform business.
  • Experience owning client implementations end-to-end, from kick-off and requirements gathering through configuration, launch, training, and post-launch adoption.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple client implementations/projects simultaneously, including project plans, timelines, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.
  • Strong external stakeholder management skills, with experience working directly with client decision-makers and influencing customers when priorities or expectations need to be challenged.
  • Strong internal stakeholder management, including the ability to influence and push back effectively with Sales, Account Management, Product, Operations, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Comfortable working with data and performance metrics to identify issues, measure adoption, and make recommendations to customers.
  • Experience working with technical or systems-based implementations. Candidates should be comfortable discussing integrations and troubleshooting with technical teams; exposure to APIs, SFTP, expense integrations, or similar systems is preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience training customers and presenting to stakeholders.
  • Able to operate independently in a fast-paced environment, prioritising multiple customers and resolving implementation issues with limited supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong prioritization skills - able to manage your time effectively, prioritizing high-value clients, while working with multiple customers to deliver on goals and improve processes.
  • Outstanding interpersonal skills, both written and verbal communication, and strong group facilitation skills.
  • Outstanding organizational skills and the ability to balance your attention to detail with swift execution - we need to do things quickly and seamlessly.
  • Speed, resourcefulness, and a go-getter attitude. Be agile and thrive when operating in new spaces and fast-paced environments.
